query:
UPDATE ht_customers
            SET cust_firstname = $1,
                cust_lastname = $2,
                cust_phone = $3,
                cust_email = $4,
                cust_idcard = $5,
                cust_address = $6,
                cust_type = $7,
                cust_notes = $8,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE cust_id = $9
